text:
maya: Deploybot flagged a canary p99 tail-latency spike on /embeddings-hosted after v5.0.0 rollout at 10:12. Suggests revert. Proposing manual cutback to v4.9.8 and a short safety pin while we triage.

deploybot: Auto-recommendation: revert to v4.9.8 (confidence 0.90). Signals: p99 +700ms, kv-evict-rate +22%. Awaiting operator confirm (2m).

tom: oncall. +1 to cutback. prefer staged 50% -> 100% then pin. I'll run the split and monitor traces.

maya: command: `redwoodctl traffic split --env prod --from v5.0.0 --to v4.9.8 --pct-start 50 --pct-final 100 --step-interval 2m --reason "p99 tail latency spike"`

tom: kicking job now. monitoring dashboards and trace sampler.

deploybot: Job jb-99881 accepted. Step1 (50%) completed in 32s. Observed p99 improving toward baseline.

tom: moving to 100% early due to steady improvement.

deploybot: Shift complete: 100% -> v4.9.8. p99 returned to baseline.

maya: applied pin: `redwoodctl pin --env prod --version v4.9.8 --ttl 30m --reason "safety pin after canary rollback"`. Disabled auto-rollforward for the rollout. Opening INF-6001 for RCA.

alice: drafting customer blurb: "We temporarily routed a subset of traffic to a previous model version to address increased tail latency. No customer data was exposed. We'll follow up with timeline and next steps."

ops-bot: Incident stub posted to #statuspage and customer template queued.

maya: follow-ups assigned: INF-6001 -> tom (kernel trace + kv metrics), maya (customer comms + release notes), raj (staging repro).

tom: thanks all. closing execution thread; will reopen with RCA notes if needed. :white_check_mark:
